title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!! — Episode4 Growth From Defeat

meta.Event Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You've really been battling against them every day. How have things been going? Have you managed to win yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I still haven't won against anybody...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ♪ーーーーーーーーーーーーーー~~~~~!!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Oh, that was a close one.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Yeah...
If she was just a bit more polished, I would've been done for.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so close. I might finally win...!)
Oh, you guys are really going at each other!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: These windbags just showed up at my doorstep... Seven, eight... I can't believe you're all here.
Yeah, we're living overseas now, so it took us some extra time to get back.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We weren't the only ones who performed at RAD WEEKEND, remember?

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:
That makes twelve in total.
You have to defeat us one at a time.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Not only that, these guys are still active, so I've gotta think they're gonna put up much more resistance than us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're better than the others...? But there are so many of them...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have to win against even more people now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
That's quite the predicament...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I can't lie. I really envy your situation.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, you're facing off against active pros who performed at RAD WEEKEND. I wish I could battle against them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I know things are tough... But you're definitely gonna come out stronger once it's all said and done.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Just keep doing your best to hang in there, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best to win and catch up to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome, you trained one-on-one with An's dad and ignited the entire neighborhood all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi, you took all our feelings and turned them into that amazing song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And your task is so hard, An.
But you're doing your absolute best to complete it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I also need to complete mine...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I still haven't finished mine yet, so I'll be trying just as hard as you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...!
Let's do our best together, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(What am I supposed to do...?
On top of me needing to build more stamina, even my singing skills still leave a lot to be desired...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I... I just have to keep doing everything I possibly can to get better...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (To do what RADder did that time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, my singing has to surpass that. It needs to resonate even more...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?
A message? But it's so late...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I need you to battle against me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But I sang with everything I had.
I did better than I ever had while training.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I know I'm supposed to use that feeling to propel myself forward.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But that doesn't make it less frustrating.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't sing like the way they do.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't throw absolutely everything I have into my singing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I...was really hoping that I could get her excited.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An has this way of singing that makes my heart race...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I... I still haven't been able to do the same for her.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I want to get her excited.
I want to surprise her. I want her to smile and laugh.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(That's the way I want to sing.
Which is why...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (More excitement! More than what An achieved that time...!)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member B
rows.Line:
Alright, you got me.
I can't top that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If you do, then no one is going to hear you!)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member C
rows.Line:
...
Now I see why Taiga took you under his wing.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member D
rows.Line:
You're batting like one for five now, right?
I can't believe how fast you're improving...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member D
rows.Line: I'm starting to understand how you and Taiga feel. I like how she's able to respond so quickly.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member D
rows.Line: It's been so long since I last sang this hard. You're one tough girl.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(Looks like she's figured it out.
Her head seems much clearer now. She can focus on each song without anything getting in the way.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (And we have An to thank for what she did the other day. She's become such a good partner.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (You have just one to go, Kohane.)

rows.Speaker: RUST Leader
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm the final boss.
You can go first.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member D
rows.Line:
Get ready!
Our leader's racked up the most wins against RADder!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can sing like them! I know I can!)

rows.Speaker: RUST Leader
rows.Line: What you just did... I can't do anything against that.

rows.Speaker: RUST Leader
rows.Line:
You blew my mind to pieces.
The last time this happened was during that night...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I felt it too just now.
Like being struck by a bolt of lightning.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's easily the best I've ever heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Of course, you're still pretty rough around the edges, but now you have the power to create the moment we talked about.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, that concludes your first task.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: You sounded so amazing just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... I'm not sure that I have a good grasp of what I just did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I'm going to keep practicing. In order to learn how to sing like that at will.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Yeah, good plan.
If you can master what you just did, then you guys will have a way better chance of surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: We wanna see the moment when Nagi's dream becomes a reality. We promise to be there when it happens.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for taking all this time out of your busy schedules to help me like this...!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah, good luck!
Do your best!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I promised An that I'd watch her practice after this, but you're free to use this place if you want to keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Mind watching her for a bit, Granny?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Alright, I can do that.
But I'm booting her if she stays too late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...!
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to get going—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, before you do, I'd like to ask you a question...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You said that you'd tell me once I've completed my first. So, I was wondering...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: My original plan was to tell you once you'd completed your first task...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But I've decided to tell you on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? The day of the event?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's right. For now, don't think about it. Just keep practicing and focus on mastering what you did just now.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And don't forget to be yourself when you sing...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, I really need to get going. So do all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh... Thank you very much!
Please take care of yourselves, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really want to know what my second task involves...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But for now, I need to focus on mastering what I just did.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to figure out how I'm going to create that moment on my own. So that we can surpass RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Hey, you're going to lose your voice if you keep singing so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? This looks like... Is this hot water?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Yes, with some honey and ginger.
It'll be good for your throat.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
I used to make this so often for Nagi...
That girl also had a habit of practicing too hard and losing her voice.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Anyway, make sure you drink it while it's still hot.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Still, you've really become quite the singer. You have me doing double takes.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Hm? You don't seem all that happy despite the compliment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry... I wasn't trying to be rude...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm just worried whether I'll really be able to blast a hole in that moment like he said...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone congratulated me today on passing and the way I sang...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I still don't have a good understanding of what I did. So, I'm worried about what's going to happen when we do this for real...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: I believe you have more than what it takes to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: If there's anything missing still, I'd say...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: You need to take a look at yourself.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
That's right.
Or more specifically, you need to find your “ego”.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Yes, since the ones with the biggest egos always end up becoming the best singers.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: I've hosted and gone to a lot of different events in my time.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Some were horrible, while others I'm never going to forget for as long as I live.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Unfortunately, the ones who come up with events like that tend to be pretty self-centered.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Yes. To be fair, some were kind, honest and polite on the outside like you. But I'd usually find out that they're egotistical down to the core.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: They never listen to anyone else and try to get their way, even if it means causing others around them a lot of trouble... They're always a handful.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: But they're the ones who'll do whatever it takes to change the status quo, like you're trying to blast a hole in that moment. People like Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: And that's what makes events like the one she put on unforgettable. The way she pushed herself to the absolute limit as she sang...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: And so, if you feel that you're still missing something, that's what I think you should start looking for.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does wanting to surpass RAD WEEKEND count as having an ego...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
I don't know.
Everyone's different. You can't just tell someone else who they are.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: That being said, I think your case is relatively simple. You just need something plain and simple that drives you forward.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: A thing that you want to do no matter the cost, no matter how much trouble you cause.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: I believe something like that is what fuels a person's ego.
